covers: the resume batch for the K = 7 bank cases that the first bridge run did not reach
does_not_cover: -- all four are produced under v2 and under the v2 code hashes
why: The first bridge run (K = 2,3,5,7) completed every K = 2, 3 and 5 case and 39 of the 119 K = 7 cases before it was stopped so that the panel ladder could run inside the 28-core budget. The remaining K = 7 cases are re-queued here. The K >= 10 batch additionally needs a shorter per-probe budget and a stratified subsample to fit the budget, which changes scripts/stage292_bridge.py.
changes_to_scripts_stage292_bridge_py: PROBE_SECONDS for K = 10 and K = 12 lowered from 900 s to 240 s
per-case wall for K >= 10 lowered from 10800 s to 1200 s
STAGE292_STRIDE environment variable: keep every STRIDE-th case of the list sorted by (K, reference_set_size), i.e. a size-stratified subsample
STAGE292_OUT and STAGE292_SKIP environment variables so a batch can be resumed without re-running cases already recorded
